Headline results of agent run /home/hyoklee/poro/agent/results/run_20261115T155359Z_s20 (report.py output, exit 0):

Coverage / inputs:
- Records analysed: 759 (stride 20, 2016-03-18T02:09:17Z to 2016-03-26T00:59:44Z, 3.314 % of the time window)
- Anomalous records (|robust z| > 5): 57
- DAS detections: 62 in 53 records; relative b 0.9849 (34 above Mc)
- Pumping: injected 4.654e+05 m3, extracted 5.059e+05 m3, net -4.048e+04 m3 over 15.96 days
- Catalogue: 5 events, ML -0.48 to 0.07 (GDR 859, LBNL/NCEDC March 2016)

CALIBRATED probabilities (catalogue-based, Shapiro et al. 2021 Eq. 5; the LBNL catalogue magnitudes are calibrated, so these are the calibrated numbers):
- b = 1.0:  Sigma = -5.449, P(Mw>=5.5)/yr = 0.0001198, P(Mw>=5.5) over the observed volume = 5.236e-06, P(M>=3)/yr = 0.03719
- b = 0.73: Sigma = -5.319, P(Mw>=5.5)/yr = 0.004922,  P(Mw>=5.5) over the observed volume = 0.0002155, P(M>=3)/yr = 0.2809
- b = 0.65: Sigma = -5.281, P(Mw>=5.5)/yr = 0.01474,   P(Mw>=5.5) over the observed volume = 0.0006484, P(M>=3)/yr = 0.4653

UPPER BOUND (DAS-based, uncalibrated magnitudes; every detection counted as an event at or above the catalogue Mc, so it over-counts):
- b = 0.9849, Sigma = -2.698, P(Mw>=5.5)/yr = 0.07842

Interpretation: the calibrated (LBNL catalogue) P(Mw>=5.5) per year ranges from ~1.2e-4 (b=1.0) to ~1.5e-2 (b=0.65); the DAS-based value of 0.0784/yr is an upper bound only, because DAS magnitudes are uncalibrated and the counting over-counts events.
